pathology_report:
Biopsy 1 (2023): The specimen showed benign prostatic tissue with no evidence of malignancy. Gleason score 0+0, ISUP grade group 0. No cribriform or intraductal patterns identified. No perineural invasion was observed. The sampling was located in the transition zone, mid right.

Biopsy 2 (2025): The specimen revealed adenocarcinoma. Gleason score 3+4, ISUP grade group 2. The growth pattern was acinar. No cribriform or intraductal patterns identified. The tumour was located in the transition zone, mid right.

Overall, there has been an upgrade from benign findings to ISUP grade group 2 adenocarcinoma across the two biopsy timepoints.
